caption: The drawing depicts a transparent glass oil can with a wide, conical base and a narrow neck. It has a single, curved handle attached to one side, rendered in shades of gray to indicate the transparent nature and thickness variations of the glass. The lid is metallic, colored in a brass or gold tone, and is secured by a central cylindrical spout, also metallic and vertically oriented. A thin metal chain, also brass-colored, is attached to the lid and connects to a small, conical cap hanging down the side of the can. The background is a plain, light beige, with some faint spots and no additional objects or designs present. The drawing uses light and shadow for dimensionality and realism.
title: Camphene Lamp
